name: io.github.rascal-3/chainanalyzer-mcp
description: Blockchain AML for AI agents: risk scoring, sanctions, tx & bridge tracing across 12 chains.

environmentVariables.name: CHAINANALYZER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ChainAnalyzer API key (tfk_...) for subscription billing (Pro plan or higher). Use this or X402_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hex EVM private key. When set, the server pays each call automatically in USDC on Base via x402 (no account, no extra install). Use a dedicated low-balance wallet with no EIP-7702 delegation. Use this or CHAINANALYZER_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Per-call x402 payment limit in USD (default 1.00). Calls priced above it are refused before signing; batch_screening ($2.50) needs 2.50 or more.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: x402 payment network: base (default and only supported value)

environmentVariables.name: CHAINANALYZER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://chain-analyzer.com)
